Two M6.1 earthquakes were reported on 6 November 2026, so it's not clear which one you mean:

- **Off eastern Japan (shallow):** One report, citing the USGS, places it about 156 km southeast of Hasaki, Chiba Prefecture. Another puts it about 202 km east-southeast of Chiba City. The Japan Meteorological Agency gave a preliminary M6.1 with seismic intensity 3, and no tsunami warning was issued. ([WION](https://www.wionews.com/world/magnitude-6-1-earthquake-strikes-eastern-japan-near-tokyo-jma-says-deaths-damage-details-1793963304231), [Earthquake Track](https://earthquaketrack.com/quakes/2026-11-06-10-39-24-utc-6-1-10))
- **Fiji–Tonga area (deep, 541 km):** The U.S. Embassy in Suva reported it, with the epicentre about 251 km south of Kabara Island. I couldn't confirm that this location is USGS-sourced. ([U.S. Embassy Suva](https://fj.usembassy.gov/earthquake-alert-u-s-embassy-suva-fiji-november-6-2026))

I didn't open the USGS event pages directly, so check [earthquake.usgs.gov](https://earthquake.usgs.gov) to confirm which event matches your 6.1.
